issues.message: The word limit for the essay task is too restrictive and may not allow candidates to fully develop their ideas.
issues.suggestedAction: Consider increasing the word limit to 220-250 words.

issues.message: The review task may not be the most authentic genre for this topic, as workplace observation days are not typically reviewed in the same way as products or services.
issues.suggestedAction: Consider using a more authentic genre, such as a reflective essay or a report.

issues.message: The topic of the article task may be too similar to the essay task, and may not allow candidates to demonstrate their full range of writing skills.
issues.suggestedAction: Consider using a more distinct topic for the article task, or adding more specific requirements to the task instructions.
